result.summary: The page is mostly polished, but a few areas look visually clipped or obstructed, especially horizontally scrolling content and the bottom navigation overlay.

issues.description: The fixed bottom navigation appears to cover part of the restaurant list content. The second restaurant card image continues underneath the nav bar, making the content feel obstructed.
issues.suggestion: Add sufficient bottom padding or safe-area spacing to the scrollable content so cards are not hidden behind the fixed navigation bar.

issues.description: Several horizontal carousel items are cut off at the right edge, including the category chip after “Healthy” and the third restaurant card in “Fastest near you.” This can look accidentally cropped rather than intentionally scrollable.
issues.suggestion: Add clearer carousel spacing, a fade edge, or ensure partial cards are clipped consistently so the horizontal scroll affordance feels intentional.

issues.description: The third restaurant name in the “Fastest near you” row is truncated by the screen edge, making it unreadable.
issues.suggestion: If partial cards are shown, avoid displaying clipped text below them, or use a proper ellipsis within the card bounds.
